description: Takes the person's notes that point at times in the video, like 'at 0:28 a weird blur with the plant and the blue chair' or 'at 0:33 remove the older gentleman', passed in their own words. Notes without a time work when the words name the shot ('drop the closet shot'). It finds the shot or transition at each time on the saved video (or the shot the words name), looks at that spot (the photo and the rendered clip), names the element and the cause, and returns one plan with the first fix for each note (tool and arguments) and the credit cost of any fix that uses one. Editing notes ('start with the kitchen', 'make the pool shot longer') come back as the edit itself (move_shot, remove_shots, set_shot_length). Free fixes can be made straight away; credit fixes are requested with the tools it names. In the Keylight editor it checks each spot again after the fix renders. Uses no credit.

aspect.description: Optional: the version they watched, if they said.

creditLimit.description: Optional: the most credits the person said these notes may use.

aiPlus.description: The most AI+ credits the fixes may use.

photoEdits.description: The most photo edit credits the fixes may use.

notes.description: The person's revision notes, word for word, with their times when they gave them.

watched.description: Only after the plan asked which version they watched: editor (the video as it is now) or download (the last file made).
